{{Top|leg}}
'''Repulsor projectors''' were [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] technology used in the construction of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[collector-repulsor array]] that required low-yield [[repulsorlift motor]]s. The [[G-wave]]s of hundreds of projectors were focused by a large dish, creating a field that was capable of distorting the crustal pressures of a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The resulting [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] and [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] eruptions could devastate a civilization.<ref name="Science">{{WEGCite|story=Ain't Science Grand?|book=Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)}}</ref>
